reason: This plugin is primarily a web UI feature extension for DeepSeek Harness that streamlines skill selection by adding a composer-side picker button and inserting the corresponding `/skill` draft token on user selection. Its documented behavior and manifest show it is a DSH plugin extension with UI integration and localized skill descriptions rather than a standalone automation or data-processing tool.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的插件，在输入栏工具栏增加技能选择入口，用户可在下拉菜单中选取技能并将对应的 `/技能名 ` 写入输入草稿以便快速使用。
summaries.en: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness Web extension that adds a skill picker in the composer toolbar, allowing users to select a skill from a menu and insert the corresponding `/skill` draft text with one click.

capabilities: Adds a UI control to the web composer toolbar for selecting skills
Reads skill definitions via existing `skill.list` RPC source
Inserts selected `/技能名 ` text into the conversation input draft
Provides bilingual labels/descriptions for available skills

reasons.code: The README describes a browser-side Cordis client plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web composer toolbar that adds a "技能" button and writes `/技能名 ` into the input draft when selected.
The manifest declares a web client bundle (`dsh.client.platform: "web"`) and patch-based injection, confirming this is a plugin intended for host UI extension rather than a standalone service.
The README states the menu uses `skill.list` RPC data with search/filter behavior and session-level cache handling, indicating remote skill-list retrieval plus local client state.
